info.name: Dash0 Edge Collectors Prometheus API API
Evaluates and returns a formatted version of the query.

params.name: query
params.description:
PromQL expression to validate and pretty-print. The response `data` is the
formatted expression. If the query contains Dash0 template variables (e.g.
`$__range`, `$__interval`), the original query is returned unmodified.

info.name: Returns a list of label values for a provided label name.

params.name: label_name
params.description: The label name whose values are returned.

params.name: start
params.description: Start timestamp to restrict the set of returned label values.

params.name: end
params.description: End timestamp to restrict the set of returned label values.

params.name: match[]
params.description: Repeated series selector that restricts the label values returned.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to and is capped at the server-configured maximum.

params.name: dataset
params.description: Dataset to query. Defaults to the organization's default dataset.

info.name: Returns metadata about metrics currently scraped from targets.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of metrics to return. When omitted, all metrics are returned.

params.name: limit_per_metric
params.description: Maximum number of metadata entries to return per metric.

params.name: metric
params.description:
If provided, only metadata for this metric name is returned. When omitted,
metadata for all metrics is returned.

params.name: start
params.description: Start timestamp. Must be provided together with `end`.

params.name: end
params.description: End timestamp. Must be provided together with `start`.

params.name: dataset
params.description: Dataset to query. Defaults to the organization's default dataset.

info.name: Evaluates a PromQL expression over a range of time.

params.name: query
params.description: PromQL expression to evaluate.

params.name: start
params.description: Start timestamp of the range (inclusive).

params.name: end
params.description: End timestamp of the range (inclusive). Must not be before `start`.

params.name: step
params.description: Query resolution step width, as a duration or a number of seconds.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Per-query timeout, clamped to the server-configured maximum.

params.name: limit
params.description:
Maximum number of returned series. Defaults to and is capped at the
server-configured maximum.

params.name: dataset
params.description: Dataset to query. Defaults to the organization's default dataset.

params.description: Start timestamp to restrict the set of returned series.

params.name: end
params.description: End timestamp to restrict the set of returned series.

params.name: match[]
params.description:
Repeated series selector that selects the series to return. Upstream
Prometheus requires at least one selector.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to and is capped at the server-configured maximum.

params.name: dataset
params.description: Dataset to query. Defaults to the organization's default dataset.
